name: io.github.jestatsio/astra-mcp
title: JEStats Astra DB Plugin
description: Unofficial Astra DB integration by JEStats: query, vector search, guarded writes, and views.

environmentVariables.name: ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Astra application token (AstraCS:…). Optional when the project .env or ~/.astrarc provides one.

environmentVariables.name: ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Data API endpoint of the default database. Optional when the token sees one database.

environmentVariables.name: ASTRA_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide write and schema tools.
